Workflow ideas

Find a vaulted design

Use the controlled identifier, current revision and relationship context. In the intended SOLIDWORKS PDM preview, find a vaulted design; the visible result is the matching record, document or model tree with ownership visible. Review source system, revision, permissions and record identity before accepting or exporting it.

Check out and revise files

Start from the proposed change, exchange or coordination package. In the intended SOLIDWORKS PDM preview, check out and revise files; the visible result is a versioned change set with affected objects and approvals exposed. Review scope, dependencies, recipients and comparison accuracy before accepting or exporting it.

Route an approval workflow

Begin with the release, transmittal or review criteria. In the intended SOLIDWORKS PDM preview, route an approval workflow; the visible result is a traceable status view with history and outstanding decisions. Review approvers, effective revision, audit trail and delivery state before accepting or exporting it.
